title: Event probability and resolution
purpose: Audit event-contract histories for overlooked information diffusion and resolution relationships.

readyWork.summary: Audit event-contract histories for overlooked information diffusion and resolution relationships.
deliverables: Source readiness inventory with provenance, availability, cost and gaps
At most three distinct mechanisms and one preregisterable experiment or blocker
Evidence-linked candidate result and handoff within the experiment budget
acceptanceCriteria: Versioned contract rules, cancellations, disputed outcomes, settlement delays, executable prices and correlated events.
Use existing data only; do not open sealed outcomes
Record biases and remain DATA_FEASIBILITY or DATA_BLOCKED; no predictive promotion
Compare overlapping prior candidates and preserve their locked outcomes
